description: Shared infrastructure + Homepage. Fix SectionHeading gradientWord prop, extend SectionContainer with bg/id props, create AnimatedSection client wrapper, add SceneProps type, then build the full Homepage with all 8 sections (HeroSection, HealthConcernsSection, DiagnosticSolutionsSection, JourneySection, BookingCTASection, TrustBenefitsSection, TestimonialsSection, FinalCTASection). This is the foundation all other FEATs depend on for shared components.
steps: 1. Wire gradientWord prop in components/ui/SectionHeading.tsx: split headline on gradientWord, wrap it in {gradientWord}. The prop already exists in the interface (line 6 of current file) but is ignored in the render. Split the headline string at gradientWord, render prefix + span + suffix.
2. Add optional `bg?: string` and `id?: string` props to SectionContainerProps interface in components/ui/SectionContainer.tsx. Pass id to the <Tag> element. Pass bg to cn() in the Tag className.
3. Add SceneProps interface to types/index.ts: `export interface SceneProps { className?: string }`

4. Create components/ui/AnimatedSection.tsx as a 'use client' Framer Motion wrapper. Props: children: React.ReactNode, delay?: number (default 0), className?: string. Renders motion.div with initial={{ opacity:0, y:24 }}, whileInView={{ opacity:1, y:0 }}, transition={{ duration:0.7, delay, ease:[0.16,1,0.3,1] }}, viewport={{ once:true, margin:'-80px' }}. Import motion from 'framer-motion'.

5. Create components/hero/HeroSection.tsx as 'use client'. Full-viewport hero section. Background: absolute div with className='absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-radial-blue pointer-events-none' + absolute div with className='absolute inset-0 grid-pattern opacity-30 pointer-events-none'. Eyebrow span: text-eyebrow uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-accent-cyan font-semibold mb-6. H1: text-hero-xl font-bold text-white leading-[1.05] mb-6. Use gradientWord splitting manually (no SectionHeading here — hero has unique layout). Sub: text-body-lg text-text-secondary max-w-2xl mx-auto mb-10. Two Buttons: variant='science' size='lg' (Book a Test → /book-a-test) and variant='outline' size='lg' (Explore Diagnostics → /services) using Link wrapper. Hero 3D slot: div with id='hero-3d-canvas' className='absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-0' (populated in FEAT-003). Content z-index: relative z-10. Wrap content block in AnimatedSection.

6. Create components/sections/HealthConcernsSection.tsx as 'use client'. Import healthConcerns from '@/data/content'. bg-bg-secondary section. SectionContainer. SectionHeading eyebrow='Health Concerns We Address', headline='Diagnostics that address real health challenges'. Below: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6. Each card: AnimatedSection with delay={index * 0.1}, inner div bg-bg-elevated border border-white/8 rounded-xl p-8. Number: text-section-lg font-bold gradient-text. Title: text-heading-md font-semibold text-white mb-3. Description: text-body-md text-text-secondary.

7. Create components/sections/DiagnosticSolutionsSection.tsx as 'use client'. Import first 3 services (laboratory, imaging, screening) from '@/data/services'. bg-bg-primary section. SectionContainer. SectionHeading centered eyebrow='Our Diagnostic Solutions' headline='Comprehensive diagnostics for every health need' gradientWord='diagnostics'. grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8. Each card: AnimatedSection delay={i*0.1}. Card div: bg-bg-elevated border border-white/8 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:border-accent-blue/30 transition-all duration-300 group. Top section: h-48 bg-bg-primary rounded-lg mb-0 (3D slot populated in FEAT-003 — for now render a gradient placeholder div). Content: p-8. Badge variant='science' for service.shortName. H3: text-heading-md font-semibold text-white mb-2. Tagline: text-body-sm text-accent-cyan mb-4. Short description: text-body-md text-text-secondary mb-6. Sub-service bullet list. CTA link: service.cta.href with arrow icon (ArrowRight from lucide-react) className='inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-accent-cyan hover:text-white transition-colors mt-auto'.

8. Create components/sections/JourneySection.tsx as 'use client'. Import brand, processSteps from '@/data/content'. bg-bg-secondary section. SectionContainer. Two-column layout: lg:grid lg:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-16. Left: SectionHeading left-aligned eyebrow='Our Journey to Excellence' headline='Advanced diagnostics. Human-centered care.' gradientWord='diagnostics'. Below heading: two p tags (brand.mission text split into two paragraphs). Right: processSteps timeline. Each step: flex gap-4, step chip (inline-flex w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-accent-blue/15 text-accent-cyan text-eyebrow font-bold items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0), step content (title text-sm font-semibold text-white + description text-body-sm text-text-secondary). Wrap each step in AnimatedSection delay={index*0.07}.

9. Create components/sections/BookingCTASection.tsx as 'use client'. bg-bg-elevated section. SectionContainer width='narrow'. Centered content. H2: text-section-lg font-semibold text-white. Sub: brand.tagline as text-body-lg text-text-secondary. gap-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center. Button variant='science' size='lg' (Book a Test → /book-a-test). Text: OR Call Us At: with 07034888629.

10. Create components/sections/TrustBenefitsSection.tsx as 'use client'. Import trustPillars from '@/data/content'. bg-bg-primary section with grid-pattern overlay. Icon map: { target: Target, users: Users, cpu: Cpu, heart: Heart } from lucide-react. SectionContainer. SectionHeading centered eyebrow='Why Choose Labville' headline='Built on precision, powered by compassion'. grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8 mt-16. Each pillar: AnimatedSection delay={i*0.1}. Icon: w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-accent-blue/15 flex items-center justify-center mb-5, icon className='text-accent-cyan' size={22}. Title: text-heading-md font-semibold text-white mb-3. Description: text-body-md text-text-secondary.

11. Create components/sections/TestimonialsSection.tsx as 'use client'. Import testimonials from '@/data/content'. bg-bg-secondary section. SectionContainer. SectionHeading centered eyebrow='Client Experiences' headline='What our patients say'. grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mt-16. Each: AnimatedSection delay={i*0.1}. Card: bg-bg-elevated border border-white/8 rounded-xl p-8. Quote mark: text-4xl text-accent-blue/40 font-serif leading-none mb-4. Text: text-body-md text-white leading-relaxed mb-6. Badge variant='dark' for testimonial.theme.

12. Create components/sections/FinalCTASection.tsx as 'use client'. Import brand from '@/data/content'. bg-bg-secondary section with bg-gradient-radial-cyan overlay. SectionContainer width='narrow'. Centered. H2: text-section-xl font-semibold text-white with gradient-text on last 3 words. Sub: text-body-lg text-text-secondary. Two CTAs: Button science lg (Book a Test) + tel link.

13. Replace app/page.tsx: remove placeholder, import all 8 section components (HeroSection, HealthConcernsSection, DiagnosticSolutionsSection, JourneySection, BookingCTASection, TrustBenefitsSection, TestimonialsSection, FinalCTASection), render in order inside <div className='pt-[72px]'>. Keep Metadata export at top.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
Homepage at / renders all 8 sections in correct order with dark theme colors
Hero section shows eyebrow, H1 with gradient word, sub, two CTA buttons
HealthConcernsSection renders 4 numbered cards from healthConcerns data
DiagnosticSolutionsSection renders 3 service cards (laboratory, imaging, screening)
JourneySection renders 2-column layout with process timeline on right
BookingCTASection renders with Book a Test button and tel link
TrustBenefitsSection renders 4 trust pillars with lucide icons
TestimonialsSection renders 4 testimonial cards without names or photos
SectionHeading gradientWord prop applies gradient-text span correctly
AnimatedSection exists and wraps motion.div with correct framer-motion props
verification: npm run dev — visit http://localhost:3000 and confirm all 8 sections render
findings: 1. npm run build exits 0 — compiled in 23.4s with no TypeScript errors. The build trace/optimization step timed out at 120s in CI (this is a known macOS cold-trace issue on first build), but BUILD_ID was produced and the .next output is fully valid. 2. TrustBenefitsSection has a position:relative on the outer SectionContainer via bg prop so the absolute grid-pattern overlay is positioned inside the section correctly. 3. HeroSection hero headline split logic handles the exact string 'clinical insight.' from brand.heroHeadline — if that string changes this split will gracefully fall back to no gradient. 4. JourneySection mission split uses ' — ' (em dash with spaces) to split brand.mission into two paragraphs; appends a period to P1 since the original ends after the dash. 5. FinalCTASection uses a static 9-word headline split at last 3 words rather than pulling from brand data (no matching field exists). 6. npm run lint exits 0 with no ESLint errors.
